description: A solution .zip to import. Importing the version that is already installed changes nothing unless force is set.

path.description: Absolute path of the solution .zip on this computer.

mode.description: update (default): import over the installed version. upgrade (managed): also delete components the new version no longer has. stage (managed): import as a holding solution only.

overwriteUnmanagedCustomizations.description: Overwrite unmanaged customizations of the same components. Default false.

publishWorkflows.description: Turn on the solution's workflows after the import. Default true.

force.description: Import even when the same version is already installed.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variable values for the target: schema name → value.

connectionReferences.description: Connections for connection references: logical name → connection id. Online only.
